parameters.content:
## Campaign launch interface

Keep this form inactive until real locations, websites, and doctor assignments are verified. A dedicated n8n Basic Auth credential is required. The entered location name and HTTPS website must match one active practice profile; existing doctors cannot be silently reassigned to another location. Each campaign currently targets one location and website. Workflow 02 sends invitations. A campaign name and month may be launched only once.
